map.→ 打开品牌名生成器工具: -> Open the brand name generator tool
map.不必须。很多品牌中文与英文是不同词（如「小米 / MI」），但需保证视觉与发音联: Not strictly required. Many brands use different Chinese and English words (such as "Xiaomi / MI"), but the visual and phonetic associations should stay consistent so users are not confused.
map.中英文品牌名必须一致吗？: Must the Chinese and English brand names match?
map.为新茶饮品牌起名: Name a new tea drink brand
map.为系列 SKU 起统一前缀：在母品牌下批量衍生风格一致的子系列名。: Give a series of SKUs a common prefix: derive a batch of consistent sub-series names under the parent brand.
map.依据行业、调性与关键词组合生成品牌名称候选并提示可注册性思路，辅助创业命名与营销: Generates brand name candidates from the industry, tone and keyword combinations and suggests ideas for registrability, helping with startup naming and marketing planning; everything is generated locally in the browser.
map.新消费品牌/子品牌线命名：按品类与调性（专业/亲切/高端）生成中英文组合，缩短头: Naming a new consumer brand or sub-brand line: generate Chinese and English combinations from the category and the tone (professional / friendly / premium) to shorten the brainstorming.
map.核心类目在第 35 类（销售/电商）与产品类（如 30 类食品、25 类服装）注: The core class is 35 (sales / e-commerce) plus the product classes (such as class 30 for food and class 25 for clothing); going overseas also requires checking the trademarks and domains of the target country, so run a similarity search after generating.
map.跨境电商店铺与独立站命名：生成易拼读、易记的英文品牌词，便于海外用户搜索与口碑传: Naming a cross-border e-commerce shop and its independent site: generate English brand words that are easy to spell and remember, so overseas users can search and spread the word.
map.：品类填「茶饮」、调性填「国风」，生成「茶语集、青岚、一盏春」等；其中「青岚」二: : with the category set to "tea drinks" and the tone to "traditional Chinese", it generates names such as "Chayu Ji", "Qinglan" and "Yizhan Chun"; "Qinglan" has a unified feel and a domain like qinglan.com is easy to register, so it suits a premium line.
